test_definition: Semantic positive plus response topology maps to proposition-response identity.
Exact-only proposition pair absent from semantic registry enters connectivity.
Exact accepted pair superseded by later semantic negative does not enter connectivity.
Same proposition with different response topology becomes variant candidate.
Behavior versus willingness blocks same proposition family.
Nested target creates hierarchy, not merge.
Derived index remains separate from constituent item.
Input row order does not change effective pair authority or IDs.
Adding coordinate relation cannot join components.
Removing positive edge cannot enlarge a component.
Adding hard negative cannot improve classification.
Every component pair matrix has n(n-1)/2 rows.
Every candidate lifecycle transition appears in state machine.
Every registry object uses exactly one identity strategy.
One governing source authority exists per pair fact.
Every canonical family revision belongs to one release and stable family.
Delete one exact-only proposition pair and effective count fails.
Allow exact overlap to override semantic negative and precedence test fails.
Break a schema $id or $ref and schema-registry test fails.
Insert unknown vocabulary value and validation fails.
Remove authority_release_id from canonical record and schema fails.
Create candidate without complete pair matrix and closure fails.
Set P3 value portability to authorized and fail.
Create canonical family without exclusion and fail.
Create family revision without stable family and fail.
Create self-parent release or genealogy cycle and fail.
Trust in police with multiple response forms remains one proposition with variants.
Satisfaction with economy stays separate from economic condition evaluation.
Environmental protection versus growth stays separate from climate mitigation versus growth.
Past petition signing stays separate from willingness to sign.
General prayer stays separate from named prayer practices.
All 18,831 semantic origin ruling IDs resolve.
All 19,175 effective pair keys are unique.
658 connectivity facts reconcile to 641 semantic plus 17 exact-only.
Schemas validate templates/examples with local registry and no network.
DDL table/column dictionary and foreign-key graph reconcile.
Release snapshot and change ledger reconcile to object registry.
Fresh extraction and recursive ZIP integrity pass.
No generated cache or bytecode debris.
P3A output preserves source licensing references.
All 13,526 lineages reconcile to 399 proposition-incident, 2,897 constraint-only, and 10,230 no-current-direct-pair-authority.
Change collision binding from scope_type to a nonexistent column and validation fails.
Insert two governing source authorities into one pair fact and schema/validator fail.
Insert administrative metadata proposition into substantive candidate connectivity and eligibility gate fails.
Assign two membership roles to one candidate member in one revision and uniqueness fails.
Use wrong object type for a polymorphic reference and type-contract validation fails.
Accept family with rejected near-neighbor but no named exclusion and close gate fails.
Canonical serialization produces identical hashes across key order, row order, and platform newline variation.
Every artifact catalog row marked delivered resolves to an exact file; every planned output is absent or explicitly generated by its phase.
Identity contract covers every registry object type and pair-fact/component/signature/segment/collision/closure IDs reproduce from canonical serialization.
Remove one object-type identity row and identity-coverage gate fails.
Use an unauthorized object type in a candidate, component, variant, or hyperedge role and type/cardinality validation fails.
Omit DIRECT_UNRESOLVED from candidate pair counts or make state totals differ from n(n-1)/2 and packet closure fails.
Attempt UPDATE or DELETE on immutable adjudication or event tables and database enforcement rejects it.
Insert noncontiguous or disallowed candidate/release lifecycle event and transition trigger rejects it.
Point runtime promotion at a release whose latest status is not PROMOTED and promotion trigger rejects it.
Governing section contains no scaffold, placeholder, TODO, TBD, FIXME, or unclassified future output.
Plan lock, execution sequence, resume control, current state, and master handoff agree on Plan v4 and P3A_CONTRACT_AND_PILOT_V4_IMPLEMENTATION.
Every content-addressed schema and example obeys the identity-pattern registry.
Wrong content-hash prefix, revision ordinal, or inherited upstream ID is rejected.
Wrong hyperedge role, object type, authority effect, or role cardinality is rejected.
Split/hierarchy/blocked decisions without their required normalized child records fail status-specific validation.
Canonical serialization fixed vectors reproduce equivalent hashes and reject duplicate set members/floats.
